dutyReason.workload: Picked for fair workload — most room left under their monthly duty limit
dutyReason.weekendBalance: Picked to balance weekends — furthest behind on their fair share of weekend duties
dutyReason.fridayBalance: Picked to balance Fridays — furthest behind on their fair share of Friday duties
dutyReason.dayFillGuarantee: assigned to guarantee the day was covered, usual fairness caps were relaxed
dutyReason.fallback: chosen by the backup scheduler because the exact solver could not finish
dutyReason.solverOptimal: Best possible schedule under the fairness rules
dutyReason.solverTimeLimit: Best schedule found within the time limit, not proven to be the best possible
dutyReason.solverFirstFriday: their only Friday duty this month
dutyReason.solverFirstSaturday: their only Saturday duty this month
dutyReason.solverFirstSunday: their only Sunday duty this month
dutyReason.solverRepeatWeekday: repeats a Friday, Saturday or Sunday only because the day could not reach its minimum staffing otherwise

reports.calendarLoadFailed: Failed to load the duty roster calendar
reports.noScheduleDescription: Generate a schedule for this month to produce a report.

rules.subtitle: Every dynamic scheduling rule lives here. Changes apply to new previews and generations immediately and are recorded in the activity log.

cycle.title: On-call duty cycle
cycle.help: Days between open on-call duties — the red-bordered days in schedules. The first open on-call day is {date}.

slots.title: On-call slots
slots.help: How many on-call doctors a single day holds in this clinic. Open on-call days, the day after an open one, and all other (closed) days each use their own count. Each count can go up to the clinic's active doctors.
slots.exceedsActive: On-call slots cannot exceed the clinic's {n} active doctor | On-call slots cannot exceed the clinic's {n} active doctors

minimums.title: Minimum on-call doctors
minimums.help: The fewest on-call doctors a day may hold. Open on-call days, the day after an open one, and all other (closed) days each use their own minimum. Each minimum must not exceed its slot count. Any count from the minimum up to the slot count is accepted; filling every slot is preferred.

holidays.subtitle: Mark clinic holidays for scheduling
holidays.discardMessage: You have unsaved holiday changes for this month. Switching months will discard them.

users.resetPasswordDescription: Set a new password for this user. The current password is not needed.
users.deleteDoctorMessage: Delete doctor {email}? They will be permanently hidden from the list. Past duties in published schedules are kept. This cannot be undone.
